articles.title: ‘Trump Strait’: US President renames Hormuz after rejecting 7-day ceasefire offer
articles.summary: Donald Trump stirred controversy by renaming the Strait of Hormuz to 'Trump Strait' in response to Iran's rejected offer. Iran’s foreign minister warned that normal maritime traffic could be restored in seven days if the US accedes to certain demands.

articles.title: 70-year-old gang-raped, murdered after objecting to men drinking near her home
articles.summary: In Lucknow's Mohanlalganj area, a 70-year-old woman was gang-raped and killed by two men. The assault occurred after she objected to their alcohol consumption near her home.

articles.title: Why Swades actress Gayatri Oberoi walked away from Bollywood
articles.summary: Gayatri Oberoi gained recognition for her role as Gita in the film Swades, alongside Shah Rukh Khan. After achieving success, she decided to step away from the film industry to focus on her marriage and family.

articles.title: Ashley Park recalls cancer battle at 15: ‘I wouldn’t be here today’ without life-saving blood donors
articles.summary: Ashley Park, now 35, recalls her isolation during leukaemia treatment and the critical role of blood donors. She emphasizes the importance of acknowledging anonymous donors who contributed to her survival.

articles.title: MrBeast in India for 'Ramayana' promotions?
articles.summary: MrBeast recently visited Agra with his wife and team, which excited his Indian fans. He could be promoting the film 'Ramayana' at a special event on September 26.

articles.title: Prince Harry Takes a Leap for a Promise, Then Calls Meghan Markle
articles.summary: Prince Harry made headlines by bravely jumping out of a plane in Canada for a charity event honoring veteran Ed Marshall, who is 102 years old. Though Marshall couldn't join due to his age, his grandson Bailey filled in for him.
